feature_queries.name: recency_and_counts
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, t.t_dat, t.price, t.sales_channel_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS cnt_7d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS cnt_14d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS cnt_30d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days') AS cnt_60d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS cnt_90d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days') AS cnt_180d,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt_365d,
    COALESCE(SUM(price) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'),0) AS spend_30d,
    COALESCE(SUM(price) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'),0) AS spend_90d,
    COALESCE(SUM(price) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS spend_365d,
    AVG(price) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS avg_price_30d,
    STDDEV_POP(price) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS std_price_90d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sales_channel_id) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS n_channels_90d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND sales_channel_id=1) AS ch1_30d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND sales_channel_id=2) AS ch2_30d,
    MAX(t_dat) AS last_t_dat
  FROM tx
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  customer_id, timestamp,
  cnt_7d, cnt_14d, cnt_30d, cnt_60d, cnt_90d, cnt_180d, cnt_365d,
  spend_30d, spend_90d, spend_365d, avg_price_30d, std_price_90d,
  n_channels_90d, ch1_30d, ch2_30d,
  CASE WHEN last_t_dat IS NULL THEN 99999 ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', last_t_dat, timestamp) END AS days_since_last,
  CASE WHEN cnt_30d=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(cnt_7d AS DOUBLE)/cnt_30d END AS frac_7d_over_30d,
  CASE WHEN cnt_90d=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(cnt_30d AS DOUBLE)/cnt_90d END AS frac_30d_over_90d,
  CASE WHEN spend_90d=0 THEN 0 ELSE spend_30d/spend_90d END AS spend_frac_30_over_90,
  CASE WHEN spend_365d=0 THEN 0 ELSE spend_90d/spend_365d END AS spend_frac_90_over_365
FROM agg

feature_queries.name: decay_features
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.t_dat < e.timestamp AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS c0,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.t_dat < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'  AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS c1,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.t_dat < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days' AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS c2,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.price) FILTER (WHERE t.t_dat < e.timestamp AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'),0) AS s0,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.price) FILTER (WHERE t.t_dat < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'  AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days'),0) AS s1,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.price) FILTER (WHERE t.t_dat < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days' AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'),0) AS s2
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  customer_id, timestamp,
  (1.0*c0 + 0.5*c1 + 0.25*c2) AS decayed_cnt_30d,
  (1.0*s0 + 0.5*s1 + 0.25*s2) AS decayed_spend_30d,
  (c0 - c1) AS cnt_lastweek_minus_prev,
  (s0 - s1) AS spend_lastweek_minus_prev
FROM base

feature_queries.name: purchase_gaps
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    t.t_dat
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days'
), ord AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp, t_dat,
    LAG(t_dat) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, timestamp ORDER BY t_dat) AS prev_t
  FROM tx
  WHERE t_dat IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', prev_t, t_dat)) AS avg_gap_days_180d,
  STDDEV_POP(DATE_DIFF('day', prev_t, t_dat)) AS std_gap_days_180d,
  MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', prev_t, t_dat)) AS min_gap_days_180d,
  MAX(DATE_DIFF('day', prev_t, t_dat)) AS max_gap_days_180d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN ord o
  ON o.customer_id=e.customer_id AND o.timestamp=e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: seasonality_trends_dense
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    t.t_dat, t.price
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days'
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS cnt_w0_7d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat <  timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS cnt_w1_7d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat <  timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days' AND t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '21 days') AS cnt_w2_7d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t_dat <  timestamp - INTERVAL '21 days' AND t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '28 days') AS cnt_w3_7d,
    COALESCE(SUM(price) FILTER (WHERE t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'),0) AS spend_w0_7d,
    COALESCE(SUM(price) FILTER (WHERE t_dat <  timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' AND t_dat >= timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days'),0) AS spend_w1_7d
  FROM tx
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  customer_id, timestamp,
  cnt_w0_7d, cnt_w1_7d, cnt_w2_7d, cnt_w3_7d,
  spend_w0_7d, spend_w1_7d,
  (cnt_w0_7d - cnt_w1_7d) AS cnt_delta_w0_w1,
  (cnt_w1_7d - cnt_w2_7d) AS cnt_delta_w1_w2,
  CASE WHEN cnt_w1_7d=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(cnt_w0_7d AS DOUBLE)/cnt_w1_7d END AS cnt_ratio_w0_w1,
  CASE WHEN spend_w1_7d=0 THEN 0 ELSE spend_w0_7d/spend_w1_7d END AS spend_ratio_w0_w1
FROM agg

feature_queries.name: nth_last_recency
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    t.t_dat
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp, t_dat,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, timestamp ORDER BY t_dat DESC) AS rn
  FROM tx
  WHERE t_dat IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  MIN(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN DATE_DIFF('day', t_dat, e.timestamp) END) AS days_since_txn_1,
  MIN(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN DATE_DIFF('day', t_dat, e.timestamp) END) AS days_since_txn_2,
  MIN(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN DATE_DIFF('day', t_dat, e.timestamp) END) AS days_since_txn_3
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN ranked r
  ON r.customer_id=e.customer_id AND r.timestamp=e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: weekday_habit
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    t.t_dat
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '84 days'
), tagged AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp,
    EXTRACT('dow' FROM timestamp) AS asof_dow,
    EXTRACT('dow' FROM t_dat) AS txn_dow
  FROM tx
  WHERE t_dat IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tagged.txn_dow = EXTRACT('dow' FROM e.timestamp)) AS cnt_same_dow_84d,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt_any_dow_84d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN tagged
  ON tagged.customer_id=e.customer_id AND tagged.timestamp=e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: basket_day_stats
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    CAST(t.t_dat AS DATE) AS tx_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'
), per_day AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp, tx_date,
    COUNT(*) AS items_in_day
  FROM tx
  WHERE tx_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT per_day.tx_date) FILTER (WHERE per_day.tx_date >= CAST(e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AS DATE)) AS n_purchase_days_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT per_day.tx_date) AS n_purchase_days_90d,
  AVG(items_in_day) FILTER (WHERE per_day.tx_date >= CAST(e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AS DATE)) AS avg_items_per_day_30d,
  MAX(items_in_day) FILTER (WHERE per_day.tx_date >= CAST(e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AS DATE)) AS max_items_per_day_30d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN per_day
  ON per_day.customer_id=e.customer_id AND per_day.timestamp=e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: purchase_day_longer_horizon
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    CAST(t.t_dat AS DATE) AS tx_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
), days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, timestamp, tx_date
  FROM tx
  WHERE tx_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT days.tx_date) FILTER (WHERE days.tx_date >= CAST(e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' AS DATE)) AS n_purchase_days_180d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT days.tx_date) AS n_purchase_days_365d,
  CASE WHEN MAX(days.tx_date) IS NULL THEN 99999 ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(days.tx_date), CAST(e.timestamp AS DATE)) END AS days_since_last_purchase_day
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN days
  ON days.customer_id=e.customer_id AND days.timestamp=e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: channel_purchase_day_stats
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    CAST(t.t_dat AS DATE) AS tx_date,
    t.sales_channel_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'
), per_day_chan AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp, tx_date, sales_channel_id
  FROM tx
  WHERE tx_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tx_date) FILTER (WHERE sales_channel_id=1 AND tx_date >= CAST(timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AS DATE)) AS days_ch1_30d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tx_date) FILTER (WHERE sales_channel_id=2 AND tx_date >= CAST(timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AS DATE)) AS days_ch2_30d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tx_date) FILTER (WHERE sales_channel_id=1) AS days_ch1_90d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tx_date) FILTER (WHERE sales_channel_id=2) AS days_ch2_90d
  FROM per_day_chan
  GROUP BY 1,2
), last_chan AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN t.sales_channel_id=1 THEN t.t_dat END) AS last_ch1_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN t.sales_channel_id=2 THEN t.t_dat END) AS last_ch2_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  COALESCE(agg.days_ch1_30d,0) AS days_ch1_30d,
  COALESCE(agg.days_ch2_30d,0) AS days_ch2_30d,
  COALESCE(agg.days_ch1_90d,0) AS days_ch1_90d,
  COALESCE(agg.days_ch2_90d,0) AS days_ch2_90d,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(agg.days_ch1_90d,0)+COALESCE(agg.days_ch2_90d,0)=0 THEN 0
       ELSE CAST(COALESCE(agg.days_ch2_90d,0) AS DOUBLE)/(COALESCE(agg.days_ch1_90d,0)+COALESCE(agg.days_ch2_90d,0)) END AS frac_days_online_90d,
  CASE WHEN last_chan.last_ch1_time IS NULL THEN 99999 ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', last_chan.last_ch1_time, e.timestamp) END AS days_since_ch1,
  CASE WHEN last_chan.last_ch2_time IS NULL THEN 99999 ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', last_chan.last_ch2_time, e.timestamp) END AS days_since_ch2
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN agg
  ON agg.customer_id=e.customer_id AND agg.timestamp=e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN last_chan
  ON last_chan.customer_id=e.customer_id AND last_chan.timestamp=e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: price_quantiles_90d

WITH tx AS (

feature_queries.name: article_mix_extended_90d
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, t.article_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp

)
SELECT
  x.customer_id, x.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.product_group_name) AS n_prod_groups_90d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.index_group_name) AS n_index_groups_90d,

  COUNT(DISTINCT a.department_name) AS n_departments_90d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.product_type_no) AS n_product_types_90d
FROM tx x
LEFT JOIN article a ON a.article_id=x.article_id
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: purchase_day_regularity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    CAST(t.t_dat AS DATE) AS tx_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days'
), days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, timestamp, tx_date
  FROM tx
  WHERE tx_date IS NOT NULL
), ord AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id, timestamp, tx_date,
    LAG(tx_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, timestamp ORDER BY tx_date) AS prev_date
  FROM days
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', prev_date, tx_date)) AS avg_gap_purchase_day_180d,
  STDDEV_POP(DATE_DIFF('day', prev_date, tx_date)) AS std_gap_purchase_day_180d,
  MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', prev_date, tx_date)) AS min_gap_purchase_day_180d,

  ON ord.customer_id=e.customer_id AND ord.timestamp=e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: postal_popularity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    postal_code,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY postal_code) AS postal_customer_cnt
  FROM customer
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  c.postal_customer_cnt AS postal_customer_cnt,
  LN(1 + c.postal_customer_cnt) AS log_postal_customer_cnt
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN c
  ON c.customer_id=e.customer_id

feature_queries.name: category_concentration_90d
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    t.article_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days'
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    tx.customer_id, tx.timestamp,
    a.section_name, a.product_group_name, a.product_type_no
  FROM tx
  LEFT JOIN article a ON a.article_id=tx.article_id
), sec AS (
  SELECT customer_id, timestamp, section_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), grp AS (
  SELECT customer_id, timestamp, product_group_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), ptype AS (
  SELECT customer_id, timestamp, product_type_no, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), totals AS (
  SELECT customer_id, timestamp, COUNT(*) AS total_items_90d
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1,2
), best AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id, t.timestamp,
    MAX(sec.cnt) AS max_sec_cnt,
    MAX(grp.cnt) AS max_grp_cnt,
    MAX(ptype.cnt) AS max_ptype_cnt,
    t.total_items_90d
  FROM totals t
  LEFT JOIN sec   ON sec.customer_id=t.customer_id   AND sec.timestamp=t.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN grp   ON grp.customer_id=t.customer_id   AND grp.timestamp=t.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN ptype ON ptype.customer_id=t.customer_id AND ptype.timestamp=t.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2,6
)
SELECT
  customer_id, timestamp,
  max_sec_cnt, max_grp_cnt, max_ptype_cnt, total_items_90d,
  CASE WHEN total_items_90d=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(max_sec_cnt AS DOUBLE)/total_items_90d END AS frac_top_section_90d,
  CASE WHEN total_items_90d=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(max_grp_cnt AS DOUBLE)/total_items_90d END AS frac_top_prod_group_90d,
  CASE WHEN total_items_90d=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(max_ptype_cnt AS DOUBLE)/total_items_90d END AS frac_top_product_type_90d
FROM best

feature_queries.name: novelty_30d_vs_365d
feature_queries.sql:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    a.product_group_name
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  LEFT JOIN article a
    ON a.article_id=t.article_id
), prior AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    a.product_group_name
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND t.t_dat >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
  LEFT JOIN article a
    ON a.article_id=t.article_id
), prior_set AS (
  SELECT customer_id, timestamp, product_group_name
  FROM prior
  WHERE product_group_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT
  e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) AS recent_items_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.product_group_name) AS recent_distinct_groups_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.product_group_name IS NULL THEN r.product_group_name END) AS novel_groups_30d,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT r.product_group_name)=0 THEN 0
       ELSE CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.product_group_name IS NULL THEN r.product_group_name END) AS DOUBLE)
            / COUNT(DISTINCT r.product_group_name) END AS frac_novel_groups_30d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN recent r
  ON r.customer_id=e.customer_id AND r.timestamp=e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN prior_set ps
  ON ps.customer_id=e.customer_id AND ps.timestamp=e.timestamp AND ps.product_group_name=r.product_group_name
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: customer_lifetime
feature_queries.sql:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, t.t_dat, t.price
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  customer_id, timestamp,
  COUNT(*) AS lifetime_cnt,
  COALESCE(SUM(price),0) AS lifetime_spend,
  MIN(t_dat) AS first_t_dat
FROM tx
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: customer_lifetime_derived
feature_queries.sql:
WITH lt AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id, e.timestamp,
    MIN(t.t_dat) AS first_t_dat
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=e.customer_id
   AND t.t_dat < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  customer_id, timestamp,
  CASE WHEN first_t_dat IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', first_t_dat, timestamp) END AS customer_tenure_days
FROM lt
